title: Installation

b)^2 / 2)   pair <- upper.tri(d) & d <= maxDist   bin <- cut(d[pair], seq(0, maxDist, length.out = nBins + 1))   v <- data.frame(distance = as.numeric(tapply(d[pair], bin, mean)),                   semivariance = as.numeric(tapply(halfSq[pair], bin, mean)))   v[!is.na(v$distance), ] } maxDist <- quantile(dist(coords), 0.25) curves <- do.call(rbind, Map(function(v, label) {   data.frame(variogram(v, coords, maxDist), field = label) }, fields, names(fields))) curves$field <- factor(curves$field, levels = names(fields)) target <- curves[curves$field == "x", ] beforeRemap <- variogram(gaussian[[which(shown == deltaStar)]], coords, maxDist) ggplot(curves, aes(distance, semivariance, colour = field)) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_line(data = beforeRemap, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +   geom_point(data = target, colour = "black", size = 2) +   coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.5 * max(target$semivariance))) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "grey60",                                  "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7")) +   labs(x = "Distance", y = "Semivariance", colour = NULL) +   theme_classic() ab <- compareSpatial(rast[c("A", "B")], nPermutations = 999, nThreads = 2,                      keepNulls = TRUE) #> compareSpatial: 1 gene on 273 shared pixels in 0.2 s (999 permutations in total, 2 threads) nulls <- attr(ab, "details")$Gene ggplot(data.frame(r = c(nulls$nullX, nulls$nullY),                   direction = rep(c("surrogates of A", "surrogates of B"),                                   each = length(nulls$nullX))), aes(r)) +   geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey70") +   geom_vline(xintercept = ab$correlationCoef, colour = "red") +   facet_wrap(~direction) +   labs(x = "Null correlation", y = "Permutations") +   theme_classic()
